title: The objectui#10024 plural defect on its sibling keys: `common.itemCount` (tab-count aria-label), `detail.reactionCount` and the ar collaboration counts read the wrong noun form in Russian and Arabic at 2 and above
body:
Filing gate ① — a product defect with named sites and a reproduction (class a).

Relayed from the objectui#10024 dev's report (`out_of_scope_findings`, PR objectui#10240). This seat re-read only what "verified" below states.

## The defect

objectui#10024 fixes one key: `search.resultsCountPlural`. The same two-key `=== 1` switch sits on sibling keys whose count-not-one value is a single noun form, so users read the wrong grammatical form today. (Placeholders are spelled COUNT and EMOJI here; the tree uses the i18next double-brace form.)

| key | locale | value (count ≠ 1) | wrong at | needs |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `common.itemCount` | ru | `COUNT элементов` (the `many` form) | 2–4, 22–24 (`few`) and 21, 31 (`one`) | элемента / элемент |
| `detail.reactionCount` | ru | `EMOJI COUNT реакций` | 2–4 (`few`) | реакции |
| `common.itemCount` | ar | `COUNT عناصر` (the 3–10 plural) | 2 (`two`) and 11+ (`many`) | the dual / the singular |
| `collaboration.commentCount` | ar | `COUNT تعليقات` | 2 and 11+ | the same |
| `collaboration.reactionCount` | ar | `COUNT تفاعلات` | 2 and 11+ | the same |

- **Where users see it:** `common.itemCount` is the tab-count accessible label in `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, selected by `Number(item.count) === 1 ? 'common.itemCountOne' : 'common.itemCount'`. `detail.reactionCount` is drawn by `plugin-detail`'s `ReactionPicker`. The dev's `Intl.PluralRules` readings: `ru` select(2) = `few`, select(21) = `one`; `ar` select(2) = `two`, select(11) = `many`.
- **Already fine, the controls:** ru `collaboration.commentCount` (`Комментариев: COUNT`) and ru `collaboration.reactionCount` (`Реакций: COUNT`) already use the count-label device.

## The precedent fix

PR objectui#10240 (objectui#10024), once reviewed: one pack value per key, rewritten as a count label (「Noun …: COUNT」) that reads correctly at every count. No new key, since the repo's key-parity test refuses a ru-only `_few`. The same device, key by key, is the expected shape.

## Verified by this seat on `origin/main` `f4f1f455`

- `packages/i18n/src/locales/ru.ts`: `itemCount: "COUNT элементов"`, `itemCountOne: "COUNT элемент"`, `reactionCount: "EMOJI COUNT реакций"` (the `detail` one); the collaboration `commentCount` / `reactionCount` are count labels already.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/ar.ts`: `itemCount: "COUNT عناصر"`, the collaboration `commentCount: "COUNT تعليقات"` and `reactionCount: "COUNT تفاعلات"`.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:871`: the `=== 1` switch between `common.itemCountOne` and `common.itemCount`.

## Reader

The `domain:ui` execution seat (objectui#5560), for its queue once triage grades it. ⛔ Filed bare: `domain:*`, type and priority are the triage seat's.

## Dedupe

The search API is refused through this seat's egress proxy. Checked instead: the objectui `board-archive` snapshot, open and closed, with `git grep -i -E`:
- `itemCountOne` ⇒ objectui#3423 (the PR that wired the badge into i18n);
- `common\.itemCount` ⇒ #3423 and #3847 (i18n backfills);
- `reactionCount` ⇒ #3390, #3423, #3424, #3438 (i18n wiring);
- `PluralRules` ⇒ #10024, #9909, #1148, #3868, #457, none about these keys;
- `plural` near `russian`/`few` ⇒ #10024 only.

A live listing of the 576 most recent open and closed cards on the same terms returns only #10024 and #9909. ⇒ no existing card.

Dedupe words: `common.itemCount russian few` · `two-key count label ru few many` · `reactionCount ru 2 реакций` · `ar dual count commentCount` · `itemCountOne plural category`

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #1, `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`, from the objectui#10024 delivery.
